messages:
maya: Heads-up — planning to enable the adaptive batching FF for small canary tomorrow morning (09:30 PT). Quick sync: who needs to veto?

luis: thumbs up from infra side. Couple asks: what audience size and rollback triggers?

emily: canary audience = 5% of production traffic, limited to org IDs in prod:audit-cohort (list) — we should route only non-payments traffic.

maya: exact list: org ids [134, 287, 902, 1102]. Start at 5% for the first 30m, then 20% for next 2h if stable.

rahul: for metrics propose watching: p95 latency, tail token latency (99th), request 5xx rate, model token throughput, and cache hit ratio. Also watch queues/backpressure for workers.

olivia: +1. Add sampling of full requests for failed traces and a breakpoint to capture KV cache miss patterns.

maya: rollback criteria (if any of the following):
- p95 increases > 40% over baseline for 15m
- 5xx rate > 0.5% sustained for 5m
- worker queue depth tops > 2x baseline for 10m
- cache hit ratio drops > 15% and correlates with latency
If any trigger fires, flip the flag and open the incident channel.

luis: what are the exact flag names and how to flip quickly?

maya: flags: `ff/adaptive_batching_v2` and `ff/batch_max_size_override`. To disable quickly:
```
# internal flag toggle
curl -s -X POST "https://flags.internal.redwood/flags/ff/adaptive_batching_v2/disable" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $FLAG_OPS_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"scope":"prod", "audience":"canary-audit"}'
```
or use FlagOps UI: https://flags.internal.redwood/ui/ff/adaptive_batching_v2

emily: make sure the automation also sets `batch_max_size_override=1` as a soft fallback if we want more graceful slowdown instead of full disable.

rahul: tagging the rollout with deployment id and sampling rate so we can slice logs: `rollout_id=rb-1975-adapt` and `sample_rate=0.01`

olivia: I'll add a quick dashboard patch: new panel for KV-prefetch misses and per-model token time. Posting grafana link once ready.

maya: deployment sits behind canary circuit-breaker. sre-bot, can you start the health probes at 09:30 and post updates?

sre-bot: Scheduled probes registered for rollout_id=rb-1975-adapt. Health checks every 30s: p95, 5xx, queue_depth, cache_hit. Alerts will post to #eng-oncall if thresholds breach.

luis: small ask for postmortem granularity: include request sample ids and model variant. Ensure logging has kv_key prefix so we can reconstruct miss patterns.

emily: doing a dry-run locally to validate behavior with the same request shape. Will post perf numbers in the morning.

maya: thanks. plan recap in case anyone joins late:
- Canary 5% -> 20% -> scale down if issues
- Monitored metrics + explicit rollback rules above
- Fast disable command + soft fallback override =1
- Logging sample + rollout_id tag
- Dashboard + probes in place
If no objections by EOD I'll schedule the toggle.

olivia: no objections from ML. I'll be on-call window 09:00-11:30 PT.

rahul: I'll monitor infra 09:00-12:00 PT and stand by to escalate.

luis: infra green. Leave notes in the flag runbook for next time: include who to paged for model-degraded cases.

maya: perfect. last_message: I'll push the schedule to the calendar and ping again 30m before. :rocket:
